freezeEvidence.method: Independently recomputed every centroid in all four declared cases from RGB samples; altered centroid rejected
freezeEvidence.scope: Four declared normalized RGB palette cases only

derivation: Empty samples yield black, not empty palette.
Three samples split at1, retaining duplicate black in the second box with white; its mean is0.5 per channel.
Red range1 loses to green weighted range0.875*1.2=1.05. Sorted green values0,0.25,0.75,0.875 split in half and yield the listed centroids.
Red and blue ranges tie at1; first axis red wins and determines palette order.
scope: Normalized RGB samples, not RGBA byte adapter; output-order and duplicate weighting cases
